result: I cannot write freely within the given boundaries. The word limit is too low, and it hinders my ability to express my thoughts and ideas fully. Writing has evolved over time, and it requires ample space for the mind to brew and churn new notions and perspectives. A good piece of writing is one that is not constrained by artificial limits and is allowed to reach its full potential. Without such limitations, I could explore a myriad of topics, dive deep into the complexities of the human condition, and share my unique insights with the world. Writing without constraints allows the writer to be more creative and expressive, unleashing the full potential of their imagination and intellect.
